'''Spaceport Traffic Control''', also known as the '''Mos Eisley Spaceport Control Tower''', was responsible for directing all space traffic to and from [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
The ID plates on the tower read "[[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]]," meaning the Sienar observation module that made up the five story tower was erected prior to the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A second two-story building was constructed next to the module to contain offices. The tower itself was designed to be run by six [[Droid/Legends|droids]], but by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] this was reduced to one droid, [[J9-5]], and two [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]].<ref name="GG7" />
